Warranty: - The vehicle is covered by a manufacturer's warranty.
- Warranty terms and conditions may vary by country.
- Certain components have extended warranty periods (e.g., high-voltage battery).
- Regular maintenance and correct use are required to keep the warranty valid.
Information stored by the control units: - Control units store data related to vehicle operation and system status.
- This includes diagnostic codes, system faults, and sensor data.
- Data may be used by service personnel for diagnostics and repairs.
- Some data may be transmitted for remote services or legal obligations.
Vehicle antennas: - The vehicle is equipped with multiple antennas for radio, navigation, and mobile communication.
- Avoid covering or damaging the antenna areas.
- Some antennas are integrated into the vehicle’s windows or roof.
Fluids in the air conditioning system: - The air conditioning system contains refrigerant and lubricating oil.
- Only qualified personnel should service the A/C system.
- Fluids are listed with reference numbers for identification and handling.
Information on the EU chemicals regulati: - The vehicle complies with European chemical regulations.
- Substances of very high concern (SVHC) are managed according to REACH requirements.
REACH: - REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) regulates chemical use.
- The vehicle's components comply with REACH legislation.
- Safety information for substances is available through the manufacturer.
Materials and recycling information: - Many components are recyclable and marked with identification codes.
- The manufacturer supports environmentally responsible recycling and material reuse.
- Customers are encouraged to dispose of materials via authorised recycling programs.
Return and scrapping of end-of-life vehi: - CUPRA provides take-back solutions for end-of-life vehicles.
- Vehicles must be delivered to authorised facilities for proper dismantling and recycling.
- National regulations apply to the return process and recovery of materials.
Declaration of conformity: - The vehicle complies with all relevant EU directives and standards.
- The declaration is available on request from the manufacturer or authorised dealers.
Radioelectrical equipment: - The vehicle includes radio equipment compliant with EU directive 2014/53/EU.
- Devices operate within approved frequency bands and power levels.
- Technical documentation is available upon request.
